name: preferences-settings
title: Preferences settings cards
description: Account display preferences: interface language, theme and timezone. Persistence and the side effects of each change (locale cookie, theme class, cache refresh) stay in the host.
postInstall: Render <PreferencesSettings labels={...} values={...} languages={...} port={...} /> inside your settings shell. The host supplies translated labels and language options, a saveLanguage/saveTheme/saveTimezone port, and applies the changed preference from the on* callbacks. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button, card, input, label and select.
